title: Growth config: ATTRIBUTION_POLICY
description: Windows and precedence of the deterministic attribution function (ARCH section 6.3). Changes need effectiveFrom >= now + 7 days and a provider announcement. Every default is PROPOSED_DEFAULT until the founder ratifies it (ARCH section 6.3 / 16). Unknown keys are rejected; secrets are never stored here, only secretRef names.

providerTouchWindowDays.description: Provider link, QR, desk, widget or provider-owned deep link counts for this many days. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 30.

patientReferralWindowDays.description: Patient referral click to registration or booking. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 30.

campaignClickWindowDays.description: Paid or owned campaign click. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 7.

visitorKeyMaxDays.description: Cap on the consent-gated visitor key lifetime. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 180.

newPatientLookbackMonths.description: Mirror of Market.featureDefaults.newPatient.lookbackMonths; informational here, the Clinic rule is authoritative. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 24.

touchEvidenceRetentionMonths.description: Raw touches linked to a decision are kept this long. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 25.

unlinkedTouchRetentionMonths.description: Touches not linked to any decision are kept this long. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 13.

minDwellMsForProviderTouch.description: A provider touch counts only if the landing page was actually rendered this long. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 1000.

ltTokenTtlMinutes.description: Lifetime of the signed in-session link token. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 30.

precedence.description: Commission precedence. FIRST_TOUCH is reporting only and is rejected for commission use by the decision function. PROPOSED_DEFAULT PROVIDER_FIRST.

allowOfflineEvidence.description: An OFFLINE source recorded by staff before check-in may make a decision PROVIDER_LED. PROPOSED_DEFAULT False.
